geometry.derivationNote: Article 3 of Federal Constitutional Law No. 5-FKZ defines the Russian domestic legal-territory extent by the DNR boundaries established by its constitution on the relevant formation/admission dates and treats the external-state-facing segment as the Russian state border. This resolves source location for the legal boundary definition only; a separately reviewed authoritative cartographic/administrative boundary geometry is still required before geometry-verified replay.

territoryChanges.notes: Russian legal-border track only; this record does not assert international recognition or de-facto control.
